name: Plum
source: One of the two automata Karakuri Dolls made by Dr. Ichigaya, whose daughter fell into a coma due to an accident. . The inventor copied his daughter's personality into the artificial intelligence of the automata, but her emotions didn't awaken within Plum. She decided to work in a hospital as a nurse apprentice. When she met the protagonist, Plum's emotions gradually awakened and she started to have "love for people".
